description: Defines the 'Note' class which models a note in the Notes App. Includes attributes for title, content, tags, and archived status, along with a method to serialize the Note object to a dictionary with an ID.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A simple domain model representing a note with attributes like title, content, tags, and archived status. Provides a method to convert the note instance to a dictionary including an ID.

methods.name: __init__(self, title: str, content: str, tags=None)
methods.description: Initializes a Note instance with a title, content, optional tags, and sets archived status to False.

methods.name: to_dict(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Serializes the Note instance to a dictionary including a provided note ID.
